notes.notes:

notes.title: All the vases are ready (sort of)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375314/fe5cc54528f5fe7fef8dee915ea08b4463afff7c.jpg[/img]
After remodeling/retexturing the 30 vases, I checked the finished models again. It turned out that nine of them weren't good enough. Now all the vases are good to go!
The next is to finish the remaining two environments, finalize the order of levels, and create 2/3 of the levels. There are other things to do, but these are the biggest challenges.

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE: new vase, difficulty settings, mouse smoothing
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375314/a19fbaaaa0abe27c0426675bfeefe4ff95862c95.png[/img]

Long time no see but for now I am releasing some interesting stuff: 
- four difficulty settings (Casual / Normal / Hard / Real)
- a beautiful new vase which means two new levels
- mouse smoothing option. It is on by  default

Have fun with this brand-new content!

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE
notes.notes:
The Antique Restorer demo has been updated once again! Now, you can view the table from a top-down perspective by pressing the SPACE key. Join us on the Steam Discussion forums to discuss this feature or any other aspects of the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375314/6fc0c4b149c1deae6f8f37b1f6b4c9501de079ca.png[/img]

notes.title: MAJOR DEMO UPDATE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43375314/21a3518c4f3b3fd6959aaadb2b588bece2d83430.png[/img]

We had a good conversation on the discussion forum of the game, and the result of that conversation is a new feature set added to the Antique Restorer demo. The new features are:

- Piece Drawer: Store important pieces in the drawer for easy access
- Hot-swapping pieces in Sliced vase levels
- Sliced vase level has been slightly adjusted to be easier
- Loading screen now includes animation and a progress bar
- Updated and new tutorials
- Added a new window that explains game controls
- Bug fixes
